research_question: Kaynaklarda Türkiye'deki en eski/ilk tünel örneği olarak tanımlanan tek yapı (Terelek Tüneli) hangi tarih, konum, yapım amacı ve temel özelliklerle aktarılmaktadır?

admitted_claims.claim_text: Terelek Tunnel was constructed beneath the Kızılırmak River in northern Turkey, probably more than 2000 years ago (possibly 5000), for defensive reasons.
admitted_claims.qualifier: One of the oldest underwater tunnels of the world; probably more than 2000 years ago (possibly 5000)

admitted_claims.claim_text: The Terelek kaya tüneli, located under the Kızıl River south of Boyabat and Durağan in Turkey, is claimed to be the world's oldest tunnel traversing under a water body and is estimated to have been built more than 2000 years ago.
admitted_claims.qualifier: claimed, estimated to have been built more than 2000 years ago

evidence_limitations: Text explicitly locates the tunnel in Turkey and dates it to antiquity, supporting early/first tunnel existence but with explicit temporal qualifiers ('one of the oldest', '2000-5000 years ago') and defensive purpose rather than an explicit 'first' designation.
